items.quote: A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David. On you he will sacrifice the priests
items.contrast: Josiah as the future sacrificer versus Jeroboam, who is merely standing by the altar to make an offering.
items.reason: Jeroboam is a plausible alternative because he is the nearby person at the altar, but the prophecy introduces Josiah and then uses “he” for the one who will sacrifice the priests. The question clearly tests who performs the predicted action.
